resources.name: NASA Open APIs
resources.use: Use the portal to discover individual services and their authentication requirements. Prefer the existing imagery connections for mission briefings.
resources.limit: This is a directory, not one gameplay dataset. Keep keys out of browser code; cache selected records.

resources.name: DONKI space weather
resources.use: Use historical flare and solar-particle events as dated storm-story prompts.
resources.limit: Research-quality events are not a guaranteed Mars forecast. A flare class alone does not determine surface radiation. Official host migrated in September 2026.

resources.name: OSDR space biology
resources.use: Use selected plant and microbial studies as evidence cards: organism, flight conditions, controls, study accession and original publication. OSD-37 provides a plant comparison.
resources.limit: Earth organisms studied in space are not Martian life. Metadata alone does not establish effect size, causation or crop yields.

resources.name: RadLab radiation instruments
resources.use: Compare readings from a named instrument, location and time interval. Teach why exposure depends on environment and shielding.
resources.limit: Absorbed dose rate is microgray/hour; dose equivalent rate is microsievert/hour. Do not treat them as interchangeable or copy ISS readings onto Mars.

resources.name: Mars Trek terrain
resources.use: Use mapped imagery for mission-site context; the existing game already uses NASA terrain. Consult WMTS layers for a future site-specific map.
resources.limit: Image tiles are not elevation grids. Respect layer projection, coverage, resolution and attribution. The current world stays Gusev-based even when another region is selected.

resources.name: CSA youth and STEM resources
resources.use: Use educator activities for debriefs, learning goals and classroom extensions.
resources.limit: This is a curated resource directory, not a live API. Link to original activities and check reproduction terms for media.

resources.name: CSA food-production toolkit
resources.use: Use food production challenges to connect crop choices with water, light, nutrition, preparation and waste. Keep packaged food in reserve.
resources.limit: Real crops grow over days or months. Game seconds and simplified food rewards must stay labelled as training rules.

snapshots.name: NASA DONKI flare history
snapshots.summary: 28 flare records. Historical solar observations; no Mars arrival prediction.

snapshots.summary: 16 instrument readings; absorbed dose rate in microgray/hour. ISS readings are not Mars surface dose or dose equivalent.

snapshots.name: Curiosity RAD on Mars
snapshots.summary: 83 archived instrument readings. Mars surface instrument readings; not a personal crew dose prediction.
examples: 2022-04-01T00:09:59 UTC / 8.974828 microgray/hour (absorbed dose rate). Dose equivalent is not inferred.

snapshots.name: LRO CRaTER around the Moon

examples: 2022-04-01T00:59:59 UTC / 49.2625 microgray/hour (absorbed dose rate). Dose equivalent is not inferred.
